claim_scope: prespecified within-OEDI-package association under a conditional bus-bundle random-label null; common passive-locality diagnostic only

robustness.lateral_definition: each source-rooted BFS edge leaving an undirected-degree>=3 node; retain the source component and evaluate only if >=50 profiles and >=10 per phase remain
robustness.secondary_inference: none_run; any future secondary p-values require Holm adjustment
robustness.weighted_distance: not run: the pinned files do not supply one coherent comparable length scale for line, switch, and transformer/regulator series elements
robustness.whole_day_shift_rule: UTF-8 SHA256('CWT-OEDI-PASSIVE-V1|SHIFT|<load_id>'), first 8 bytes big-endian modulo 365; zero means no roll and remains reported
